title: Connected topological spaces and schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space. $X$ is *connected* if it is nonempty and, whenever $X=T_1\amalg T_2$ with $T_1,T_2\subseteq X$ open and closed, one of $T_1,T_2$ is empty. In particular the empty space is not connected. A scheme is *connected* if its underlying topological space is connected.
